id: \rI think Pidgey and Rattata are cute, too!
en: \rI think Pidgey and Rattata are cute, too!
it: \rAnche secondo me Pidgey e Rattata sono carini!

id: \bPlaying games and Pokémon are like eating peanuts! I just can't stop!
en: \bPlaying games and Pokémon are like eating peanuts! I just can't stop!
it: \bI videogiochi e i Pokémon sono come le noccioline! Non riesco a smettere!

id: \bI want to try out a battle strategy.
en: \bI want to try out a battle strategy.

id: \bI am better at school than this!
en: \bI am better at school than this!
it: \bA scuola sono più bravo che in questo!

id: \bI can never lose with this plan.
en: \bI can never lose with this plan.

id: \bI was planning on getting some fresh air for a change.
en: \bI was planning on getting some fresh air for a change.
it: \bAvevo in programma di prendere un po' d'aria fresca, tanto per cambiare.

id: \rYou'll need at least two Pokémon if you want to battle us.
en: \rYou'll need at least two Pokémon if you want to battle us.
it: \rTi servono almeno due Pokémon se vuoi sfidarci.
\rHo catturato i miei Pokémon insieme a Eli.

id: \bWho gets in the way of a bike?
en: \bWho gets in the way of a bike?
it: \bMa chi si mette in mezzo a una bici?

id: \bDon't think you're all special and all just because of this.
en: \bDon't think you're all special and all just because of this.
it: \bNon credere di essere chissà chi solo per questo.
\rSto crescendo dei Pokémon insieme ad Anne.

id: \bI got grass caught up in my spokes, man.
en: \bI got grass caught up in my spokes, man.
it: \bMi si è incastrata l'erba nei raggi, amico.
\rI miei Pokémon sono i più carini.

id: \rWhen Pokémon grow up they get ugly! They shouldn't evolve.
en: \rWhen Pokémon grow up they get ugly! They shouldn't evolve.
it: \rQuando i Pokémon crescono diventano brutti! Non dovrebbero evolversi.

id: \rI hear Clefairy evolves when given a Moon Stone.
en: \rI hear Clefairy evolves when given a Moon Stone.
it: \rHo sentito che Clefairy si evolve se gli dai una Pietralunare.
